/bin/zsh -lc 'set -e
selftest_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
db="$selftest_dir/board.json"
run() { TASKBOARD_FILE="$db" bun run src/cli.ts "$@"; }
first="$(run add --title '"' First task ' --tags 'Work, urgent,work' --due 2026-09-05)\"
second=\""'$(run add --title '"'Second' --tags 'work,home' --due 2026-09-07)\"
third=\""'$(run add --title '"'Third')\"
FIRST=\""'$first" SECOND="$second" THIRD="$third" bun -e '"'const a=JSON.parse(process.env.FIRST"'!); const b=JSON.parse(process.env.SECOND!); const c=JSON.parse(process.env.THIRD!); if(a.id!==1||a.title!=="First task"||a.status!=="open"||JSON.stringify(a.tags)!==JSON.stringify(["work","urgent"])||a.due!=="2026-09-05"||!a.createdAt) throw Error("bad first add"); if(b.id!==2||c.id!==3) throw Error("unstable ids")'"'
listed=\""'$(run list --status open --tag WORK --overdue 2026-09-06)"
LISTED="$listed" bun -e '"'const x=JSON.parse(process.env.LISTED"'!); if(x.length!==1||x[0].id!==1) throw Error("filters failed")'"'
done1=\""'$(run done 1)"
done2="$(run done 1)"
DONE1="$done1" DONE2="$done2" bun -e '"'const a=JSON.parse(process.env.DONE1"'!); const b=JSON.parse(process.env.DONE2!); if(a.status!=="done"||!a.completedAt||a.completedAt!==b.completedAt) throw Error("done/idempotence failed")'"'
stats=\""'$(run stats)"
STATS="$stats" bun -e '"'const s=JSON.parse(process.env.STATS"'!); if(s.total!==3||s.open!==2||s.done!==1||typeof s.overdue!=="number") throw Error("stats failed")'"'
deleted=\""'$(run delete 2)"
remaining="$(run list)"
DELETED="$deleted" REMAINING="$remaining" bun -e '"'const d=JSON.parse(process.env.DELETED"'!); const r=JSON.parse(process.env.REMAINING!); if(d.id!==2||JSON.stringify(r.map((x:any)=>x.id))!=="[1,3]") throw Error("delete/list failed")'"'
set +e
bad_date_out=\""'$(run add --title bad --due 2025-02-29 2>"$selftest_dir/date.err")"; bad_date_status=$?
unknown_out="$(run list --bogus 1 2>"$selftest_dir/flag.err")"; unknown_status=$?
missing_out="$(run done 999 2>"$selftest_dir/missing.err")"; missing_status=$?
set -e
BAD_DATE_OUT="$bad_date_out" UNKNOWN_OUT="$unknown_out" MISSING_OUT="$missing_out" BAD_DATE_STATUS="$bad_date_status" UNKNOWN_STATUS="$unknown_status" MISSING_STATUS="$missing_status" bun -e '"'for (const [name,out,status] of [[\"date\",process.env.BAD_DATE_OUT,process.env.BAD_DATE_STATUS],[\"flag\",process.env.UNKNOWN_OUT,process.env.UNKNOWN_STATUS],[\"missing\",process.env.MISSING_OUT,process.env.MISSING_STATUS]]) { JSON.parse(out"'!); if(Number(status)===0) throw Error(name+" should fail") }'"'
cp \""'$db" "$selftest_dir/good.json"
printf '"'{broken' > \""'$db"
set +e
malformed_out="$(run list 2>"$selftest_dir/malformed.err")"; malformed_status=$?
set -e
MALFORMED_OUT="$malformed_out" MALFORMED_STATUS="$malformed_status" bun -e '"'JSON.parse(process.env.MALFORMED_OUT"'!); if(Number(process.env.MALFORMED_STATUS)===0) throw Error("malformed db should fail")'"'
test \""'$(cat "$db")" = '"'{broken'
find \""'$selftest_dir" -maxdepth 1 -name '"'.board.json.*.tmp' -print -quit | read leftover && { echo \"temporary file left behind: "'$leftover" >&2; exit 1; } || true
bunx tsc --noEmit --target es2022 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --types bun src/cli.ts
printf '"'all self-tests passed\\n'"

  fi
  lines=$(wc -l < "$out" | tr -d '"' ')

  bun -e '"'JSON.parse(await Bun.stdin.text())' < \""'$out"

if (JSON.stringify(add.tags) !== JSON.stringify(["one", "two"])) throw new Error("tag normalization failed");
